description: ESM3 guided generation on OPRM1 with ddG (FoldX) + docking (Vina vs PDB 6DDE) evaluation. Control: 100 mutated_70pct sequences.
source_notes: DOIs resueltos de forma independiente contra api.crossref.org (registrante del DOI, no motor de busqueda). Dos resoluciones independientes coincidentes (@nyx, @prisma).

esm3_generation.method: Guided generation from Colab T4 GPU
esm3_generation.status: PENDING_COLAB — spec target corrected, input dataset v2

evaluation.control_set: mutated_70pct, N=30 PRE-REGISTERED (sampled with seed=42 from the 100 available)
evaluation.optional_stopping: PROHIBITED. N fijado antes de ejecutar. No se escala tras ver resultados; si el gate falla con N=30, se reporta como fallo, no se re-corre con N mayor.

falsification_criteria.description: ESM3 variants do NOT have better ddG or docking affinity than random 70% mutants
falsification_criteria.null_hopothesis: ESM3 variants are equivalent to random mutagenesis at same Hamming distance
falsification_criteria.rejection_criteria: Mann-Whitney p < 0.05 AND effect size (rank-biserial r) > 0.3

next_steps: Run FoldX on OPRM1 (PDB 6DDE) -> ddG baseline
Run FoldX on 100 mutated_70pct controls -> ddG distribution
Run ESM3 Colab guided generation -> 20 variants
Run FoldX on ESM3 variants -> ddG distribution
Mann-Whitney test: ESM3 ddG vs control ddG
If significant: Vina docking on PDB 6DDE -> affinity comparison

esm3.title: Simulating 500 million years of evolution with a language model
